topic: Counselor Mapper and Round Robin Assignment
summary: Details the 'Counselor Mapper' functionality for automatically assigning leads to counselors based on specific courses or sources. It explains the 'Round Robin' assignment process, differentiating between the 'All' method (load balancing) and the 'Devise' method (sequential assignment).
steps: Navigate to Admission Setup > Counselor Mapper.
Select specific courses or sources for which leads need to be assigned.
Select multiple counselors who will receive leads for the chosen criteria.
The system will automatically assign leads to these counselors using a round-robin process.
**All**: Balances lead load among all counselors. If a new counselor joins, they receive leads until their load equals existing counselors, then assignment resumes one-by-one.
**Devise**: Assigns leads strictly one-by-one in sequence, regardless of existing lead load or new counselor additions.
business_rules: Leads are automatically assigned to mapped counselors based on configured rules.
The 'All' round robin method prioritizes balancing the lead load across all counselors.
The 'Devise' round robin method prioritizes a strict sequential assignment of leads.
important_notes: Counselor mapping can be configured for specific courses, sources, or a combination.
The choice between 'All' and 'Devise' round robin significantly impacts lead distribution strategy.
